footer.tagline: Modern psychological support using artificial intelligence. Available anytime, anywhere.
footer.disclaimerText: AI Psychologist is not a substitute for professional psychological care. It is a supplementary tool for supporting mental well-being. In case of serious problems, we always recommend seeking professional help.
footer.crisisLineHtml: 🛟 If you are in a crisis situation, call 116 123 (First Psychic Aid Line) or 116 111 (Child Safety Line). Help is anonymous and available 24/7.
